view.title: View fleets
view.description: See fleets, their members and inventory.

manage.title: Manage fleets
manage.description: Create, edit and delete fleets, change membership, and share fleets with other users or roles.

execute.title: Run fleet actions
execute.description: Run commands and package actions across a fleet, and transfer files to and from its member hosts.

fleets.title: Fleets
fleets.createFleetDescription: A fleet is a named group of hosts you can run actions against as a unit.
fleets.tagRulesHint: Hosts with any of these tags are automatically included, in addition to hosts added manually.
fleets.deleteFleetDescription: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This does not delete the member hosts themselves.
fleets.noFleets: No fleets yet. Create one to get started.
fleets.manageMembersDescription: Toggle hosts in or out of this fleet's static membership. Hosts matched by tag rules are always included.
fleets.noMembers: This fleet has no members yet. Add hosts or set a tag rule.
fleets.pushHint: The selected file is written to this exact path on every host in the fleet.
fleets.pullHint: The file at this path is read from every host and downloaded as a single zip, one folder per host.
fleets.inventoryNoData: No inventory data yet - refresh to collect it.
fleets.packageHint: Requires manage-level access per host and elevates using the host's stored sudo password.
fleets.shareFleetDescription: Shares this fleet's current member hosts with the selected users or roles. Hosts added to the fleet later are not shared automatically - share again to include them.
fleets.shareSelectionRequired: Select at least one user or role
fleets.fleetSharedSuccessfully: Shared {{shared}} of {{total}} host(s) in this fleet
fleets.noMembersToShare: This fleet has no member hosts to share yet.

sharing.customHoursPlaceholder: Số giờ cho đến khi hết hạn truy cập

connect.label: Kết nối
connect.description: Chỉ mở phiên: terminal, remote desktop, trình quản lý file, tunnel và Docker. Không truy cập cấu hình máy chủ.

view.label: Xem
view.description: Kết nối, cùng xem cấu hình máy chủ. Bí mật không bao giờ được hiển thị.

edit.label: Chỉnh sửa
edit.description: View, plus modify non-authentication host settings. The owner's SSH authentication stays private and owner-only.

manage.label: Quản lý
manage.description: Chỉnh sửa, và chia sẻ máy chủ với người khác, thay đổi cấp độ quyền và thu hồi quyền truy cập.

sharing.noMatches: Không tìm thấy kết quả phù hợp
sharing.searchPlaceholder: Tìm kiếm người dùng hoặc vai trò...
